description: Re-enables patch, pin, and pinDigest updates for the manager named in arg0 on the current cryostat-v* release branch. Extend as release-branch/default(managerName), after the sibling 'lockdown' preset. Update the matchBaseBranches value here whenever the active release branch changes.

packageRules.description: Enable {{arg0}} updates on the current release branch so Renovate can classify update types
Restrict {{arg0}} updates on the current release branch to patch, pin, and pinDigest
